title: Exposure-gated A/B harness with adaptive statistical gates
creator: Aisha Raman
description:
Problem: Product teams need a low-risk, configurable way to run A/B tests and canary rollouts for model versions with clear exposure control and automatic rollback when quality or safety regressions are detected. Current ad-hoc experiments rely on manual routing, lack consistent statistical checks, and have incomplete instrumentation for per-customer impact or region-level differences.

Goal: Deliver an A/B harness that supports staged exposure (shadow -> canary -> ramp), configurable exposure quotas, sequential statistical tests (e.g., sequential probability ratio test / group sequential), and deterministic auto-rollback triggers based on user-defined metrics and safety signals. The feature must integrate with Console dashboards, Redwood Optimize recommendations, and the rollout policies system so product and platform teams can safely evaluate new model variants without full deployment.

Scope: Experiment setup UI/API, exposure policy primitives (max-exposure, ramp-schedule, per-customer holdout), built-in statistical checks (ACE, ATE, p-value with alpha spending, and safety signal thresholds), automatic rollback engine that can execute pre-defined fallback to a pinned model variant, logging for audit and postmortem, and guardrails for high-risk endpoints (sensitive content or regulated workloads). Excludes model training pipelines and offline evaluation tooling beyond wiring to existing eval artifact links.
acceptance_criteria: API + Console flow to create an A/B experiment: select baseline/model variant, define exposure schedule, and choose metrics and thresholds
Configurable exposure policies: shadow-only, canary (percent ramp), and steady-state with per-customer caps
Built-in sequential statistical checks with configurable alpha spending and minimum sample sizes; results surfaced in Console
Auto-rollback action that re-routes traffic to stable variant when a metric breach or safety signal is triggered
Audit trail and change log for every rollout decision, with links to PRs and rollouts viewable in Console
End-to-end test: run a synthetic canary that triggers a rollback and confirm rollback executes and is logged
